steps: Open Home
Select About Us
Select Our Services
Select Projects
Select Contact Us
expected: Each link opens its matching page content and the active navigation item reflects the current page.

name: Review service order and About page image reveal
covers: five service images are paired with the matching About page service headings
About page project delivery and managed value proof points
six differentiator cards with supplied company strengths
two-column desktop and responsive mobile card layout
cards remain within their parent while dragging and ease back on release
keyboard movement and reset for draggable cards
description: Verifies service order, the About page service images and the project delivery figures below them.
steps: Open Our Services
Review the service cards from top to bottom
Open About Us
Scroll through the five-service reveal and compare each heading with its image
Continue below the service reveal and check the track-record figures and residential-sector statement
Continue below the track record to What makes us different
Confirm the six cards appear as two columns across three rows on desktop
Drag a card within its parent container, then release and watch it return
Focus a card, move it with arrow keys, then press Escape to reset it
expected: Quantity Surveying & Cost Management appears first, followed by Project Management, Lender Supervision & Development Advisory, Arbitration & Claims Resolution, and 5D BIM & 3D Model Quantification. On the About page, each service heading shows its matching uploaded image. After the service reveal, the track-record band before the new differentiators and team sections states that HOS Consult has delivered more than 500 projects across residential sectors and managed over $2 billion in project value, with 500+ and $2B+ figures displayed. After those metrics, the About page presents six differentiators: Client-Centric Approach, Unmatched Professionalism, Proven Track Record, Global Alliance, Local Strength, Versatility & Reach, and Integrity & Accountability. Desktop displays two columns and three rows; mobile stacks the cards. Titles and matching outlines use royal blue and dark orange. Cards stay within their parent while dragged, ease back after release, and support arrow-key movement with Escape to reset.
